name: local-everything
description: Everything conversational AI miniapp: record live transcripts into a chatbox and get answers (including rendered charts) from a Claude tool-calling backend

scripts.dev:local: bun run backend:dev:local & bun run miniapp:dev; wait
scripts.dev:doppler: doppler run --project local-everything --config dev --preserve-env -- sh -c 'EVERYTHING_BACKEND_URL=${MENTRA_PUBLIC_EVERYTHING_BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:3131}; EVERYTHING_PORT=${LOCAL_EVERYTHING_PORT:-3131}; EVERYTHING_JWKS_URL=${MENTRA_AUTH_JWKS_URL:-https://core.dev.us-west-2.mentraglass.com/.well-known/jwks.json}; EVERYTHING_ISSUERS=${MENTRA_AUTH_ISSUERS:-cloud-core,mentra}; PORT=$EVERYTHING_PORT MENTRA_AUTH_JWKS_URL=$EVERYTHING_JWKS_URL MENTRA_AUTH_ISSUERS=$EVERYTHING_ISSUERS MENTRA_PUBLIC_EVERYTHING_BACKEND_URL=$EVERYTHING_BACKEND_URL bun run backend:dev:local & MENTRA_PUBLIC_EVERYTHING_BACKEND_URL=$EVERYTHING_BACKEND_URL bun run miniapp:dev; wait'
scripts.backend:dev:doppler: doppler run --project local-everything --config dev --preserve-env -- sh -c 'MENTRA_AUTH_JWKS_URL=${MENTRA_AUTH_JWKS_URL:-https://core.dev.us-west-2.mentraglass.com/.well-known/jwks.json} MENTRA_AUTH_ISSUERS=${MENTRA_AUTH_ISSUERS:-cloud-core,mentra} PORT=${LOCAL_EVERYTHING_PORT:-3131} bun run backend:dev:local'
scripts.miniapp:pack: cd miniapp && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./miniapp.json').version") && rm -f build/com.mentra.everything-$VERSION.zip && mkdir -p build && cd dist && zip -qr ../build/com.mentra.everything-$VERSION.zip .
scripts.pack: bun run miniapp:build && bun run miniapp:pack
